label: Simple declarative + prepositional phrase
english: The cat sat on the mat.
german: Die Katze sitzt auf der Matte.
compare_note: Both languages keep subject before the verb here. The main difference is case marking on **der Matte** (dative) vs **the mat**.

label: Fronted time adverb (V2 word order)
compare_note: English keeps SVO even with a fronted adverb: **Yesterday | I | ate | an apple**. German puts the verb second: **Gestern | aß | ich | einen Apfel** — the subject follows the verb.
